items.sentence: The clerk handed a long receipt to the happy shopper.
The small bear frowned at the bitter green tea leaves.
The young dog changed its appearance with a colorful party hat.
Heat from the iron moves into cloth and smooths wrinkles.
A small bird sat safely on the boy's open palm.
Today, the mouse wore a fancy hat covered in silver ribbons.
A young cook let the beans soak inside a large bowl.
Colorful fruit bowls appeal to children choosing a healthy snack.
Students compare two maps and explain their shared symbols.
Today, the rules compel every player to move only one space.
